manual.ART-1: NOT_RUN: director must identify brand, offer, CTA and hero subject in initial captures.
manual.ART-2: NOT_RUN: director must inspect motion sequence, three material states and return against the brief.
manual.ART-3: NOT_RUN: director compares the batch and two inner sections per work.
manual.UI-1: NOT_RUN: geometry checks supplement manual inspection for clipping/overlap.
manual.UI-2: NOT_RUN: inspect focus order, control hit areas and actual composited text contrast.
manual.BIZ-1: NOT_RUN: compare both languages, values and labels to brief.
